notes:
Quick CRM notes (shorthand + call highlights):
- Company: Springbend Analytics — B2B product analytics platform; mid-market (series B, ~350 employees).
- Primary contact: Head of Engineering (Marco Ruiz), Security: Director IT Ops (Erin Park), Product: VP Product (Sofia Allen).
- Began w/ hosted API trial for embeddings (semantic doc search) + chat assistant for support flow. Embedded usage grew quickly; observed token costs rising on long transcripts.
- Demo feedback: liked Redwood's unified runtime and rollback/rollouts UI. SE call: "can we pin model version and have automatic fallback to quantized variant?"
- Performance targets: p50 chat latency <= 200ms (target 100-150ms), p95 <= 400ms. Throughput: target 40-60 concurrent chat sessions, occasional batch embedding jobs ~200 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, wants predictable committed pricing (Dedicated) to control unit economics vs hosted burst. ARR target for Redwood: $120k-$200k/yr.
- Security ask: moving from hosted to Dedicated w/ VPC peering. Must pass security review before procurement. Key items requested by their security team: SOC2 Type II report (or SOC2 in progress with compensating controls), SAML/Okta integration guide + metadata, audit log retention details (ability to export/store logs for 12+ months), KMS/HSM key management integration, data residency in US, option to redact PII at rest.
- POC scope proposed: 6-week Dedicated POC — includes reserved capacity for peak hours, end-to-end SSO test with Okta, sample audit log delivery to tenant S3, and failover behavior to smaller model families.
- Quote ask: committed 3-node reserved pool for 6 months + burst window pricing. Want explicit unit cost for embeddings and generation per 1k tokens.
- Quotes from Marco: "We need predictable bills — if latency spikes, we need auto-fallback not outages."
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (approver), Legal (needs A), Procurement (payment terms).
- Risks: Security team insists on full SOC2 artifacts; procurement timeline may slip if SOC2 not provided. Also need network diagrams for VPC peering (infra team requested).
- Suggested AE playbook: surface SOC2 report + security FAQ, provide template SAML metadata, deliver clear dedicated pricing worksheet, include sample network diagram and VPC peering checklist.
- Conversation tone: pragmatic, engineering-first, wants concrete artefacts not marketing.
- Current sentiment: engaged but cautious — progressing toward Dedicated pending security sign-off.
notes_short: Hosted API POC successful; moving to Dedicated evaluation due to cost/throughput. Security review (SOC2, SAML, audit logs) is gating procurement. AE to deliver pricing + SOC2 artifacts and schedule infra deep-dive.
